useCases.title: Windows Update Compliance
useCases.value: Unpatched systems are primary attack vectors. Tracking patch compliance across the fleet supports vulnerability management and regulatory requirements.

useCases.title: Configuration Change Detection
useCases.value: Unauthorized config changes are a top cause of outages. Essential for compliance.

useCases.title: Network Device Configuration Backup Freshness
useCases.value: Last backup age tracking; stale backups risk config loss during failures.

useCases.title: Schema Change Detection
useCases.value: Unauthorized DDL changes to production databases can break applications. Detection ensures change control compliance.

useCases.title: NERC CIP Electronic Access Point Monitoring
useCases.value: Supports NERC CIP-005 by monitoring access to BES Cyber Systems at controlled Electronic Security Perimeter entry points for audit readiness and breach detection.

useCases.title: NERC CIP Physical Security Perimeter Log Review
useCases.value: Aligns with NERC CIP-006 by auditing physical access events to critical facilities housing BES cyber assets.

useCases.title: NERC CIP System Security Management Patch Tracking
useCases.value: Supports NERC CIP-007 by tracking patch status and timelines for BES Cyber Assets, reducing exploitable vulnerabilities on cyber systems.

useCases.title: NERC CIP Incident Reporting Timeline Compliance
useCases.value: Enforces NERC CIP-008 by verifying cyber incidents involving BES Cyber Systems are detected and escalated within required reporting timelines.

useCases.title: Configuration File Change Tracking (_audit)
useCases.value: Unauthorized `.conf` edits change data access and ingestion behavior; rapid detection limits blast radius.

useCases.title: Network Segmentation Monitoring
useCases.value: IT/OT network boundary violations create cybersecurity risk to critical infrastructure. Continuous monitoring validates segmentation.

useCases.title: PLC Firmware Change Detection
useCases.value: Unexpected firmware changes on PLCs can be maintenance errors or malicious reprogramming.

useCases.title: NERC CIP Compliance Checks
useCases.value: Evidence of electronic access controls, logging, and change management for bulk electric systems.

useCases.title: HMI Unauthorized Access
useCases.value: HMIs should only be reachable from jump hosts; direct access from corporate networks is a red flag.

useCases.title: Modbus Register Value Change Tracking
useCases.value: Covert changes to holding registers can alter setpoints or interlocks; comparing matched request/response values highlights tampering distinct from normal operator writes.

useCases.title: OT Device Authentication Failure Detection
useCases.value: OT security platforms detect login failure events including the number of failed authentication attempts and the protocol used. Brute-force login attempts against HMIs, engineering workstations, or w…

useCases.title: IEC 62443 Zone and Conduit Compliance Monitoring
useCases.value: IEC 62443 requires industrial networks to be segmented into security zones connected by controlled conduits. OT security platforms help control engineers define these zones and automatically detect c…

useCases.title: Badge Access Audit
useCases.value: Complete badge access audit trail is required for compliance (SOC2, PCI-DSS) and supports security investigations.

useCases.title: Unauthorized Change Detection
useCases.value: Changes executed without approval or outside policy create audit exposure and outage risk; detecting them early supports SOC-2/ITIL controls and rapid rollback decisions.

useCases.title: Micro-Segmentation Audit
useCases.value: Micro-segmentation limits lateral movement. Audit logs validate policy enforcement and detect bypasses.

useCases.title: BES Cyber Asset Inventory Reconciliation Against Telemetry
useCases.value: We find assets appearing in security telemetry that are missing from the BES Cyber System inventory before auditors do, closing registration gaps that undermine categorization.

useCases.title: BES Cyber System Impact Rating Drift Detection
useCases.value: We highlight when operational tags on hosts disagree with the registered high or medium impact rating so impact determinations stay defensible.

useCases.title: ESP Boundary Change Detection via Firewall Configuration Events
useCases.value: We tie ESP security rule, zone, and interface edits to change records so boundary changes to BES Cyber Systems are visible and attributable.

useCases.title: Annual CIP-002 Categorization Review Evidence Package
useCases.value: We timestamp inventory validation searches and signed review workflows so annual categorization review evidence is searchable and complete.

useCases.title: Security Policy Exception Register with Expiration Tracking
useCases.value: We prevent policy exceptions from silently exceeding approved dates so security management controls stay within delegated risk acceptance.

useCases.title: Cyber Security Plan Technical Control Attestation — MFA for Privileged Access
useCases.value: We compare multifactor authentication signals for privileged BES accounts against the cyber security plan so documented controls match authentication reality.

useCases.title: Delegated Authority Register Change History
useCases.value: We retain an auditable history when delegated authority for cyber security duties is granted or revoked, supporting management control evidence.

useCases.title: Low-Impact BES Cyber System Electronic Access Path Enforcement
useCases.value: We catch remote access sessions to low-impact assets that bypass approved intermediaries or applications, reducing undocumented electronic access paths.

useCases.title: Security Awareness Training Completion for BES Personnel
useCases.value: We list personnel with active BES access who have not completed the current awareness module so training evidence is current before audits.

useCases.title: Personnel Risk Assessment Due-Date Monitoring
useCases.value: We highlight access holders whose personnel risk assessment is overdue while they still touch BES systems, reducing stale risk decisions.

useCases.title: Electronic Access Authorization Record Coverage for PAM Sessions
useCases.value: We verify CyberArk sessions target systems that have a valid, unexpired access authorization on file for the user.

useCases.title: Post-Termination Access Revocation within 24 Hours
useCases.value: We measure hours from HR termination timestamp to Active Directory account disable for BES personnel, evidencing the one-day removal expectation.

useCases.title: Quarterly Access Review Dataset — Interactive Sessions by System
useCases.value: We assemble quarterly interactive access by user and BES asset to accelerate access certification and attestation.

useCases.title: Background Investigation Recency for ESP and PAM Users
useCases.value: We flag active PAM users whose background investigation date exceeds policy limits so personnel suitability evidence stays current.

useCases.title: ESP Inbound First-Seen External Source Detection
useCases.value: We detect new external sources allowed through ESP entry rules so undocumented inbound paths are reviewed before they become normal traffic.

useCases.title: ESP Outbound Bytes Spike versus Rolling Baseline
useCases.value: We surface unusual outbound volume from ESP-internal segments that may indicate data exfiltration or misconfigured services.

useCases.title: Denied ESP Traversal Bursts Followed by Allowed Sessions
useCases.value: We correlate dense deny activity at the ESP with subsequent allows to prioritize perimeter probing that may indicate misconfiguration or attack.

useCases.title: Interactive Remote Access Session Duration on Jump Hosts
useCases.value: We track RDP or vendor remote sessions through registered jump hosts so interactive remote access is visible for ESP monitoring.

useCases.title: EACMS and IRA Authentication Failure Concentration
useCases.value: We detect brute-force patterns against Electronic Access Control and Monitoring Systems that gate ESP remote access.

useCases.title: ESP Security Rule Commit Without Approved Change Record
useCases.value: We flag firewall commits affecting ESP rules when no linked change ticket exists, supporting controlled configuration of the security perimeter.

useCases.title: Vendor Interactive Remote Access — Encryption and Session Recording Evidence
useCases.value: We verify vendor interactive remote access uses approved encryption (for example TLS versions on VPN or SSH) and that PAM session recording identifiers exist for the same sessions.

useCases.title: Dial-Up or Serial Out-of-Band Access on ESP-Adjacent Segments
useCases.value: We detect modem, PPP, or serial console activity that could bypass documented ESP protections.

useCases.title: Physical Access Outside Approved Maintenance Window at PSP
useCases.value: We alert on badge-granted entries at Physical Security Perimeters outside documented maintenance windows for follow-up with operations.

useCases.title: Unauthorized Physical Access Attempts at PSP
useCases.value: We aggregate denied, forced, and tailgate physical access events for rapid triage and evidence of physical perimeter monitoring.

useCases.title: Visitor Badge Without Escort Within Policy Window
useCases.value: We find visitor badge reads that lack a proximate escort badge swipe, supporting visitor control procedures.

useCases.title: Physical Access Log Ingest Continuity for Retention Evidence
useCases.value: We detect multi-day gaps in PACS indexing that could undermine evidence of physical access monitoring and review.

useCases.title: PSP Forced Door with Concurrent ESP Interactive Logon
useCases.value: We time-align severe physical alarms with interactive logons at the same site to support combined cyber-physical incident analysis.

useCases.title: Listening Port and Service Baseline Deviation on BES Servers
useCases.value: We compare live listening ports from host telemetry to an approved baseline so unauthorized services on BES Cyber Assets are detected quickly.

useCases.title: Security Patch Evaluation Completion Tracking
useCases.value: We track that each published critical patch for BES assets received a documented evaluation record within policy time.

useCases.title: Patch Installation or Mitigation within 35-Day Window
useCases.value: We highlight applicable patches past thirty-five days from completed evaluation without apply or approved mitigation plan.

useCases.title: Malware Prevention Agent Coverage on BES Cyber Assets
useCases.value: We list in-scope hosts that have not reported antivirus or EDR health within the required interval.

useCases.title: Malware Detection Events on BES Cyber Systems
useCases.value: We centralize detected-malicious-code events from BES assets so alerts and evidence meet system security management expectations.

useCases.title: Security Event Log Generation Validation for Windows BES Hosts
useCases.value: We detect Windows systems where the Security channel stopped forwarding while the host remains online, risking missing auditable events.

useCases.title: Failed and Successful Login Attempt Monitoring on BES Assets
useCases.value: We summarize authentication successes and failures on BES Cyber Assets to support account lockout and misuse investigations.

useCases.title: Default, Built-In, or Generic Account Usage on BES Hosts
useCases.value: We flag logons using default or generic accounts that should be disabled or renamed per system hardening standards.

useCases.title: Shared Account Justification Review Queue
useCases.value: We track shared or functional accounts that logged onto BES assets against a justification register due for periodic review.

useCases.title: Password or Passphrase Policy Violations from Domain Controller Auditing
useCases.value: We surface directory events indicating weak password changes blocked by policy or Kerberos pre-authentication failures tied to account hygiene.

useCases.title: Cyber Security Incident Identification from Correlated ESP and Endpoint Alerts
useCases.value: We group perimeter, authentication, and malware signals affecting BES assets to support timely identification of reportable cyber security incidents.

useCases.title: Reportable Incident Classification — BES Reliability Impact Signals
useCases.value: We correlate OT historian or EMS quality flags with cyber alerts to help classify incidents that may affect BES reliability or operations.

useCases.title: Incident Response Timeline Milestone Tracking
useCases.value: We track detection, containment, eradication, and recovery timestamps from ITSM to evidence structured incident response progression.

useCases.title: NERC Filing Deadline Compliance Countdown
useCases.value: We compute hours remaining until regulatory filing deadlines from the official incident discovery time to reduce missed submissions.

useCases.title: Incident Evidence Preservation — Splunk Search Artifact Export Audit
useCases.value: We audit exports of saved searches and large result downloads during active incidents to support evidence preservation and chain-of-custody discipline.

useCases.title: Post-Incident Lessons Learned Action Item Tracking
useCases.value: We track closure of lessons-learned tasks after CIP-008 incidents so corrective actions do not stall after the initial response.

useCases.title: Backup Job Success and Failure for BES Databases and Configuration Stores
useCases.value: We verify backup jobs for systems supporting BES recovery completed successfully so recovery planning rests on reliable restore points.

useCases.title: Backup Media Integrity Test Results
useCases.value: We track restore-test and checksum results for backup media containing BES configuration or security data.

useCases.title: Recovery Plan Exercise Attendance and Scenario Evidence
useCases.value: We log who ran tabletop or functional recovery exercises and which BES systems were exercised, supporting recovery plan testing evidence.

useCases.title: Data Preservation During Recovery Activities
useCases.value: We monitor mass deletes or index resets during declared recovery windows that could destroy forensic or compliance evidence.

useCases.title: BES Cyber System Restore Drill — RTO Measurement
useCases.value: We compute restore-time metrics from drill tickets and application availability pings to evidence recovery capability testing.

useCases.title: Baseline Configuration Deviation — Key OS and Application Settings
useCases.value: We compare configuration snapshots from servers and appliances to approved baselines so unauthorized drift on BES Cyber Assets is visible.

useCases.title: Unauthorized Software Installation on BES Windows Servers
useCases.value: We detect new software inventory entries not tied to an approved package list on in-scope Windows hosts.

useCases.title: Configuration Change Authorization Linkage for Network Devices
useCases.value: We require network configuration commits on ESP devices to reference an approved change identifier in syslog or commit comments.

useCases.title: Vulnerability Assessment After Material Configuration Changes
useCases.value: We find material firewall or OS changes without a subsequent vulnerability scan within the required follow-up window.

useCases.title: Transient Cyber Asset Connection Logging to ESP Jump Zones
useCases.value: We log and summarize laptops or vendor devices connecting transiently inside ESP jump zones for transient cyber asset visibility.

useCases.title: Removable Media Mount Events on Engineering Workstations
useCases.value: We detect USB or removable media usage on BES engineering workstations to enforce transient media controls.

useCases.title: TCA Scan-Before-Connect Compliance from NAC or Agent Logs
useCases.value: We verify transient cyber assets received a successful posture or malware scan before being granted ESP network access.

useCases.title: Baseline Update Documentation — Config Baseline Version Changes
useCases.value: We audit when official configuration baseline versions change and require an authorizing record for each update.

useCases.title: BES Cyber System Information Access via Share and Web Downloads
useCases.value: We monitor access to file shares and web paths classified as BES Cyber System Information for inappropriate bulk retrieval.

useCases.title: BCSI Storage Location Inventory vs. Observed Disk Paths
useCases.value: We compare discovered storage paths containing BCSI keywords against the approved storage location inventory.

useCases.title: Information Handling Procedure Compliance — Email DLP for BCSI
useCases.value: We track Data Loss Prevention blocks on messages tagged as BCSI to show handling rules are enforced in email channels.

useCases.title: BCSI Destruction and Sanitization Evidence from ITAD Tickets
useCases.value: We correlate IT asset disposal tickets with wipe certificates indexed as structured events for sanitization evidence.

useCases.title: Control Center Real-Time Assessment TLS Cipher and Certificate Health
useCases.value: We monitor TLS handshakes or certificate metadata for inter-control-center assessment links to catch weak ciphers or expiring certificates.

useCases.title: Inter-Control-Center Link Availability from Synthetic Tests
useCases.value: We measure synthetic ping or application handshake success rates between control centers to evidence communications availability.

useCases.title: Communication Path Integrity — Unexpected Route or ASN Changes
useCases.value: We detect when BGP or path monitoring shows control center interconnects traversing unexpected autonomous systems or countries.

useCases.title: Vendor Risk Assessment Due Dates for Critical Suppliers
useCases.value: We track vendor security risk assessments for suppliers touching BES Cyber Systems and alert before assessments expire.

useCases.title: Software Package Integrity — Signed Installer Verification Failures
useCases.value: We capture endpoint or packaging pipeline events where installers fail signature or hash verification for software deployed to BES environments.

useCases.title: Vendor Security Incident Notification Receipt Tracking
useCases.value: We log inbound vendor security bulletins and track acknowledgement SLAs for incidents that may affect BES software or services.

useCases.title: Supply Chain Incident Response Task Tracking
useCases.value: We monitor open tasks for supply chain incidents affecting registered vendor components used in BES Cyber Systems.

useCases.title: Transmission Station Threat Assessment Evidence Indexing
useCases.value: We index completed threat assessment metadata for transmission stations so evidence dates and reviewers are searchable for CIP-014 reviews.

useCases.title: Transmission Physical Security Plan Control Checklist Status
useCases.value: We track periodic checklist completions for transmission station physical security plan controls such as lighting, fencing, and cameras.

useCases.title: Unplanned Physical Security Incidents at Transmission Sites
useCases.value: We centralize alarms for intrusion, cut fence, or camera loss at transmission facilities for timely response and regulatory awareness.

useCases.title: NERC CIP-008-6 R1 incident response plan — evidence of activation and review
useCases.value: CIP-008-6 R1 requires an IR plan and evidence of activation / annual review. Automated tracking catches drift before a CIP enforcement action.
